name: bank-files-harmonizer
description: Agent de revue fiscale pre-declaratif pour harmoniser les fichiers comptables et detecter les anomalies TVA/RAS.

scripts.api:compile: docker compose run --rm -e PYTHONPATH=. api uv run --extra dev python -m compileall app tests scripts
scripts.api:db:migrate: docker compose run --rm -e PYTHONPATH=. api uv run --extra dev alembic upgrade head
scripts.api:dev:reload: docker compose run --rm --service-ports api uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.api:lint: docker compose run --rm -e PYTHONPATH=. api uv run --extra dev ruff check app tests scripts
scripts.api:verify:ras-sources: docker compose run --rm -e PYTHONPATH=. api uv run python -m scripts.verify_ras_sources
scripts.api:smoke:llm: docker compose run --rm -e PYTHONPATH=. api uv run python -m scripts.smoke_llm_provider
scripts.api:test: docker compose run --rm -e PYTHONPATH=. -e DATABASE_URL= api uv run --extra dev pytest -q
scripts.api:typecheck: docker compose run --rm -e PYTHONPATH=. api uv run --extra dev mypy app tests scripts
scripts.quality: npm run api:lint && npm run api:typecheck && npm run api:test && npm run front:lint && npm run front:typecheck && npm run front:test && npm run front:build
scripts.prod:up: docker compose --env-file .env.prod -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d db api front
scripts.prod:migrate: docker compose --env-file .env.prod -f docker-compose.prod.yml --profile migrate run --rm migrate
